description: Bounded graph-native goal gaps, funded target-inverse search and explicit unsupported-effect interfaces.

microtheory.name: goal_invention
microtheory.description: Regress stuck goals into typed, funded process gaps.

rules.name: gi_mint_process_gap
rules.comment: Record a typed state-transition gap when a task is stuck and no gap for that task exists.

rules.name: gi_request_targeted_rung
rules.comment: Fund one bounded target-inverse probe for an open process gap.

rules.name: gi_rung_approved
rules.comment: Begin the bounded inverse probe only after the shared budget approves it.

rules.name: gi_rung_denied
rules.comment: A denied targeted rung leaves the prior invention policy untouched and the gap unresolved.

rules.name: gi_mint_goal_targeted_inverse
rules.comment: Mint a bounded exact inverse only when its native effect strictly closes the current state-goal gap.

rules.name: gi_gap_needs_tool
rules.comment: A funded gap with no supported candidate closes as needs_tool and emits an explicit synthesis interface.
